verdict.rationale: Codegen is itself a coding agent; the evidence (docs-6, docs-26) shows it connecting to external MCP-compatible servers as a client, not hosting an official MCP server for other agents to connect to. docs-7's mention of 'provisioning MCP servers across your org' is ambiguous and tied to Claude Code integration, not a documented 'mcp serve' or hosted MCP endpoint role, so per the agent-role exception this axis does not apply.
